reuse.why: Builds getExpectedAmount on the existing getRangeAmount and the rules module's getApproxNumberThreshold, and makes getScheduledAmount delegate to it.

duplication.why: Replaces the five inline missing/number/range dispatches (preview, post, updateActions, forecast, template) with one call each.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts beside getRangeAmount and getScheduledAmount; consumers only pass their value and op.

scope.why: Touches only the amount sites and the helper; the forecast type gains just the _amountOp field it needs.

maintainability.why: One definition is easy to own, but the optional op lets callers silently skip the approximate rule, as Balance.tsx's scheduled balance does.

one_place.where: The rule lands in getExpectedAmount (shared/schedules.ts) and every loot-core path passes op, but desktop-client Balance.tsx still calls getScheduledAmount(schedule._amount) without op, so the selected-balance planning path does not apply the approximate rule.
